about_the_game:
A multiplayer first-person game with elements of social deduction (inspired by the board game "Mafia"). Here, you must uncover who among you is the secret killer.

Goal:
Win depending on your role by fulfilling your victory conditions.

Gameplay
Before the game begins, each player is randomly assigned one of three roles:

  • Monk – Peaceful and unwilling to harm anyone, but in desperate situations is ready to use force for the greater good—provided they have something to fight back with. A large-caliber revolver should do the trick.

  • Magistrate – Their goal is to secretly protect the monks. Fortunately, they have the means to do so. Just make sure no one finds out what's hidden under your cloak, or the protector might become the next victim.

  • Lotus – A secret killer disguised as a monk. Their words can deceive you, leading to decisions that may cost you dearly.

Game Process
Monks, accompanied by the Magistrate, must collect Buddha Statues to win. Of course, finding them won’t be easy—teamwork is essential. And trust me, the Lotus won’t let that happen without a fight.

Along the way, you may find potions that increase your chances of victory. Drinking them may restore your health, help you survive an attack, let you see items through obstacles, or even reveal the identity of the person in front of you.

In this game, no one can be trusted. Victory comes through cunning, teamwork, or cold steel!

name: Night Lotus

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: 64-bit Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600K / AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti or AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 30 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: 64-bit Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-9600K or AMD Ryzen 5 3600 processor
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2070 or AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 30 GB available space

short_description: A multiplayer first-person network game for 3 or more players in the social deduction genre, where victory depends on cunning or teamwork.
supported_languages:
English*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Korean, Russian, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Dutch, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal, Finnish
*languages with full audio support
